title: Almost cohomology of finite-dimensional Lie rings
summary: We introduce almost cohomology groups for Lie rings definable in finite-dimensional theory. In particular, we define the 0th and 1st almost cohomology groups of a Lie ring module. Moreover, we prove that the 1st almost cohomology group of a finite-dimensional definable Lie ring module is finite if the 0th almost cohomology group is finite.
